subject.title: feat: update Companion-owned Gateway safely in place

question: Should the repository adopt the proposed Companion-owned in-place Gateway update and layered recovery transaction after the package-lifecycle dependency lands?
rationale: The implementation adds a substantial new user-facing update, recovery, retention, and persisted-settings contract. The collaborator feedback establishes a preferred protection shape, but it does not establish final maintainer acceptance of this product boundary or its dependency split.

options.title: Land as a focused follow-up
options.body: Merge the package-lifecycle dependency first, then rebase this PR so it contains only the reviewed Gateway-alignment transaction and its completed runtime proof.

options.title: Sponsor a narrower scope
options.body: Keep version detection and user guidance, but defer rollback retention and optional VHD management to a separately approved design.

options.title: Decline the feature direction
options.body: Keep the current pinned setup behavior and close the linked product request if Companion-managed runtime alignment is not a supported product commitment.

recommendation.title: Land as a focused follow-up
recommendation.body: Merge the package-lifecycle dependency first, then rebase this PR so it contains only the reviewed Gateway-alignment transaction and its completed runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their collaborator review directly shaped the update-protection tradeoff that requires a final product and operational decision.
